intro: We currently hold only {{count}} B.Arch college in Maharashtra that meets this page's ₹{{threshold}} lakh highest-package test. That college is NMIMS in Mumbai, so this is a short list, not a wide survey of B.Arch colleges in Maharashtra with ₹50 lakh highest package.
The figure comes from our 2023 placement record for the Bachelor of Architecture. It is a historical high, not a typical offer, and it should be checked in the official placement report.
listLead: With only one college here, read the 2023 average and highest figures together. A single high offer can clear the ₹{{threshold}} lakh mark even when most of the batch earns much less.
snapshot: For NMIMS's B.Arch programme, our 2023 record shows an average of ₹27 LPA and a highest of ₹68 LPA. There is no second college on this list to compare against.
Admission to B.Arch programmes in India usually goes through NATA, along with the institute's own rules. Confirm the current NATA cycle and NMIMS's official admission notice.
firstCollegesLead: The only card is Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai. We do not hold a fee for this B.Arch row, and we have not treated any Management-category NIRF rank as an architecture rank.

compare.heading: How to read a ₹50 lakh highest package at a B.Arch college
paragraphs: A highest package is the top offer in a recorded year, not the amount most graduates received. Use the average, the year, and the official report before you draw a conclusion.
bullets: Confirm that the figure is for the five-year B.Arch programme, not for NMIMS's MBA or other degrees.
Check whether the 2023 highest includes an exceptional or international offer.
Compare this record with other top B.Arch colleges in Maharashtra 2026 on the main B.Arch listing, even if they do not meet this threshold in our file.

faqs.question: Which B.Arch colleges in Maharashtra with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: Only {{count}}: NMIMS, Mumbai. In our 2023 records, its B.Arch programme has a highest package of ₹68 LPA and an average of ₹27 LPA.

faqs.question: Is a ₹68 Lakh highest package typical for this course?
faqs.answer: No. The average in the same 2023 record is ₹27 LPA. The highest is a single top offer and can change from one batch to the next.

faqs.question: Which exam do I need for B.Arch at NMIMS?
faqs.answer: Our records link this programme to NATA, but institutes also set their own eligibility and counselling rules. Check the current official admission notice and the NATA information bulletin.

faqs.question: Why are other architecture colleges in Maharashtra missing?
faqs.answer: This page only includes colleges where we hold a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh for B.Arch. Other colleges remain on the main B.Arch listing even if they do not meet that cut.
